plan.rationale: A solo tattoo artist selling personal, custom artwork. Ink-editorial palette and modern-display type suit the craft without going clinical or generic. Layout favours a strong hero, styles as pillars, a process section reflecting a real consultation to tattoo journey, hygiene as its own weighted moment, and a gallery request since none exist yet. No prices, timelines or claims were given, so none appear.

sections.headline: Tats by Mags: Expertly Crafted Tattoos Uniquely You
sections.subheadline: Custom tattoo art by Mags, working in black and grey realism, watercolour and fine line, from concept to skin.

photoSlot.brief: A photo of Mags at work in the studio, tattoo machine in hand, taken from the side so the client's arm or the piece in progress is visible

sections.heading: Your canvas, our passion
paragraphs: Tattoos are more than ink on skin. They are stories, expressions of individuality, and lasting works of art. Mags works to turn your ideas into a personalised tattoo you will carry for life.
Every design starts with a conversation. Mags listens to your ideas, collaborates with you on the design, and makes sure every detail is right before the needle touches your skin.

items.title: Black and grey realism
items.body: Detailed, shaded work built for depth and lifelike precision.

items.title: Watercolour
items.body: Soft, flowing colour work for a more painterly, expressive piece.

items.title: Fine line
items.body: Delicate, precise linework for minimalist and detailed designs alike.

sections.heading: From your idea to the finished piece

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: You bring your ideas and Mags takes the time to understand what you want and why it matters to you.

steps.title: Design collaboration
steps.body: Together you refine the design until every detail feels right, before any ink is applied.

steps.title: The tattoo session
steps.body: Work takes place in a clean, relaxed studio environment, with your comfort considered throughout.

sections.heading: Hygiene and safety come first
sections.body: Your safety is paramount. The studio uses single-use needles and inks for every client, and follows all health and safety regulations. It is a standard Mags does not compromise on, so you can focus on the art itself.

photoSlot.brief: A photo of your sterile setup tray, single-use needles and ink caps laid out before a session

items.question: I have an idea but it is not fully formed yet, can we still talk?
items.answer: Yes. Mags works with you to develop and refine your idea through the design collaboration process, so you do not need a finished concept before reaching out.

items.question: Is this my first tattoo, does that matter?
items.answer: Not at all. Whether it is your first tattoo or an addition to an existing collection, the same care goes into listening to your ideas and creating a comfortable experience.

items.question: What hygiene standards does the studio follow?
items.answer: Single-use needles and inks are used for every client, and the studio adheres to all health and safety regulations.
